'''Shadow Brutes''' are void spirit [[Monsters]] found in [[the Mines]] after floor 80. 150 void spirits (any type) need to be killed for the [[Adventurer's Guild#Monster Eradication Goals|Monster Eradication Goal]] at the [[Adventurer's Guild]]. Both [[Shadow Shaman]] and Shadow Brutes are counted toward this goal.

==Behavior==
They have no special attacks, but resist [[Weight|knockback]].

==Strategy==
Attack them, backing away when they get close.

==History==
{{History|1.0|Introduced.}}
{{History|1.5|Added [[Shadow Brute (dangerous)]] and [[Shadow Sniper]] as stronger counterparts.}}
